01

Executive Summary

At REMIC, I researched prospective students, developed campaign creative and managed the path from acquisition to tracked conversion. I rebuilt Google Search and Performance Max with value-based bidding and tighter query controls. Reporting recorded 45,800 clicks, 2,260 tracked conversions at $35 CPA and a 21% improvement in CTR.

02

The Challenge

Connect acquisition activity with campaign economics and a useful next step for prospective students. Integrated industry campaigns and faster marketing delivery were also part of the remit.

03

The Execution

  1. Define the audience and offer

    Researched prospective students, search intent and competitive positioning to shape campaign messages.

  2. Create and launch

    Developed campaign creative and copy, then connected Search and Performance Max with social, email, web and landing-page activity.

  3. Extend the campaign

    Built Fund My Dream and industry-event promotion across formats, alongside newsletters, cart recovery, retargeting and webinars.

  4. Audit campaign controls

    Reviewed purchase goals, bidding, asset reports and tracking in the February 2025 campaign review; identified overlapping HLLQP activity for consolidation.

  5. Optimize the acquisition path

    Reworked bidding and query controls, reviewed campaign reporting and adjusted the route from click to tracked conversion.

  6. Improve delivery

    Applied AI and automation to marketing operations, improving workflow efficiency by 32%.

04
